name: Fred Devish
prior_offices: Crook County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Fred Devish is a Crook County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Sundance Times reported that he and Keith Haiar led the August 2026 Republican primary with 833 and 972 votes and advanced to the general election.
